Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi received the US response through Qatari mediators and presented it to President Masoud Pezeshkian …

candidates.title: Iran receives U.S. feedback on seven-day trust-building plan
candidates.excerpt: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi received the feedback via Qatari mediators in Doha, with the sequencing of steps the main sticking point

candidates.title: Telangana native Sandy Reddy elected Strathfield Mayor in Australia
candidates.excerpt: Telangana native Sandy Reddy has been unanimously elected Mayor of Strathfield in Australia, becoming the first Indian migrant woman to hold the post. Her election was welcomed by the Telugu community, with BRS leaders congratulating her on the achievement.

candidates.title: Police detain BRS leaders ahead of Revanth Reddy’s Sircilla visit
candidates.excerpt: Police detained several opposition leaders, activists, farmers and auto-driver representatives in Rajanna Sircilla and parts of Karimnagar districts ahead of Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy’s visit. The action came amid apprehensions of protests during his public meeting in Sircilla.

candidates.title: India criticises Pakistan’s ‘falsehoods’ and ‘deceit’ at UN; warns terrorism will have consequences
candidates.excerpt: India used its Right of Reply after Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif credited U.S. President Donald Trump for a ‘timely intervention’ in the 2025 conflict and raised the Kashmir issue

candidates.title: Wages to welfare board: Telangana gig workers seek immediate implementation of TGPW Act
candidates.excerpt: Telangana Gig and Platform Workers Union founder president Shaik Salauddin said implementing the Gig and Platform Workers Act was an immediate requirement and called for the rules to be framed and a welfare board to be constituted for the workers.
